examples.title: Example 1: Using APIs in CanvasRenderingContext2D
examples.description: This example describes how to use the APIs in CanvasRenderingContext2D for drawing on a canvas.

examples.title: Example 2: Using APIs in DrawingRenderingContext
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use the APIs in DrawingRenderingContext for drawing on a canvas.

examples.title: Example 3: Dynamically Setting Attributes and Methods of the Canvas Component Using attributeModifier
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to use attributeModifier to dynamically set the enableAnalyzer attribute and onReady method of the Canvas component.
The resources used in this example are not located in the src > main > resource directory. Starting from DevEco Studio 6.0.0 Beta2, the resources that are located outside the resources directory are not packaged by default when a project or module is created. To package these resources, go to buildOption in the module's build-profile.json5 file > resOptions > copyCodeResource, and set enable to true. For details, see the description of copyCodeResource in resOptions.

examples.title: Example 4: Creating a Canvas Component That Does Not Cache Commands for Drawing
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to use CanvasParams to create a Canvas component that does not cache commands for drawing.
The CanvasParams API is supported since API version 23.
